ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy 52a8a76cf862 (2026-05-07T07:06:44Z) modified deploy/vault/payment-service-vault-agent.hcl and deploy/k8s/payment-service/secrets-env-configmap.yaml during a secrets rotation update. The vault-agent HCL was correctly updated to write rotated certs to /vault/secrets/payment/tls/, but the Kubernetes ConfigMap that sets the MTLS_CLIENT_CERT_PATH, MTLS_CLIENT_KEY_PATH, and MTLS_CA_BUNDLE_PATH environment variables was not updated to match — it still references the old mount path /run/secrets/payment-tls/. As a result, after secrets rotation triggered a TLS config reload at 07:08:04Z, payment-service could not find the cert files at the stale path and fell back to expired in-memory certificates, causing 100% mTLS handshake failures against payment-processor.internal:8443.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Edit deploy/k8s/payment-service/secrets-env-configmap.yaml (introduced in commit 52a8a76cf862) and update the three env vars to the correct vault-agent write path: MTLS_CLIENT_CERT_PATH=/vault/secrets/payment/tls/client.crt, MTLS_CLIENT_KEY_PATH=/vault/secrets/payment/tls/client.key, MTLS_CA_BUNDLE_PATH=/vault/secrets/payment/tls/ca-bundle.crt. 2. Apply the corrected ConfigMap with `kubectl apply -f deploy/k8s/payment-service/secrets-env-configmap.yaml`. 3. Perform a rolling restart of the payment-service deployment (`kubectl rollout restart deployment/payment-service`) so pods pick up the new env vars. 4. Verify payment-service logs show successful TLS reload and confirm charge requests return 200 OK.
